311 Car. 640
Supreme Court of Carrow.

QUENTIN ASHBY HOLDINGS, LLC, Appellee,
v.
DRAVEN TOOL & DIE CO., Appellant.

No. 18 CAP 2025
|
Decided April 2, 2026

Opinion

OPINION ANNOUNCING THE JUDGMENT OF THE COURT

JUSTICE PRYOR

An expert's opinion that rests on assumptions the record does not support cannot defeat summary judgment. Draven's engineer assumed a load the machine never carried.

The order of the Superior Court is affirmed.

Justices Ruiz and Tellander join the opinion announcing the judgment of the Court.

Justice Haverford files a concurring opinion in which Chief Justice Stamm joins.

Justice Moyle files a dissenting opinion.

JUSTICE HAVERFORD, CONCURRING

I agree with the result but not with the lead opinion's statement that an expert's opinion that rests on assumptions the record does not support cannot defeat summary judgment.

JUSTICE MOYLE, DISSENTING

An expert may rely on reasonable assumptions, and a court that weighs those assumptions at summary judgment usurps the jury's role.
